0022600196.text: The 76ers (8-2, first in the Atlantic and the East) come into Chicago on a one-game losing streak to face the Bulls (1-7, 14th in the East and fourth in the Central, five games back), who have lost six straight. Philadelphia won the last meeting 126-107 in Philadelphia on November 2, and it leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after going 1-2 against Chicago in 2025-26. Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Joel Embiid is day-to-day with plantar fasciitis and a game-time decision; Chicago is without Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness), while Jalen Smith (finger sprain) and Tobe Awaka (knee sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
